I develop time series methods for matrix-valued data, where each observation is a matrix of variables across units such as countries, sectors, or regions.
Two papers on cointegration and co-movements in these models appear in *Economics Letters* and *Econometrics and Statistics*.
My current work develops impulse response inference for matrix autoregressions.
